events.head: Read live Live Control status and T-417

events.text: Still missing creds and scopes. Check the run sheet count and run the probe.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check run sheet, T-417, probe usage

events.name: Bash
events.head: List control keys and probe header

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find zoom admin routes and probe runner
events.input: $ grep -on '"/admin/api/zoom/[a-z_/]*"' cloud/src/*.ts | sort -u | head; grep -n "6000\|\[:" workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py | head -5; ls app/scripts | grep -i "live-control\|run-probe" | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Summarize live control payload and probe runner docs

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how prior runs started the local probe
events.input: $ grep -n -i "probe\|wrangler dev\|vendor-sim\|8880" cloud/seat/README.md | head -15; grep -o 'wrangler dev[^"]\{0,200\}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-226.json | tail -3; grep -o 'vendor-sim.py[^"]\{0,120\}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-226.json | tail -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe section and find runner script
events.input: $ sed -n 38,55p cloud/seat/README.md; ls app/scripts | grep -i "run-probe\|local-centre\|centre" ; grep -ln "probe-live-control" app/scripts/* cloud/scripts/* 2>/dev/null

events.text: Checking Live Control (still missing Zoom creds and scopes); now starting a local centre to rerun the probe.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Look for local centre startup recipe
events.input: $ grep -n "8880\|8882\|vendor-sim\|wrangler dev\|ADMIN_KEY\|BOT_KEY\|PERSIST" app/scripts/run-chain.sh cloud/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -15; sed -n 14,40p app/scripts/probe-live-control.mjs

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read run-chain local setup
events.input: $ sed -n 30,60p app/scripts/run-chain.sh; head -5 cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py; grep -n "argv\|port" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -5; ls cloud/.dev.vars* 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find env var names for local centre
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && grep -n "ADMIN_TOKEN\|ADMIN_KEY\|ZOOM_BOT_KEY\|SIM_URL\|SEAL\|_KEY:" src/env.ts src/types.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "interface Env" src | head -2; grep -n "database_name\|binding" wrangler.toml | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read Env interface and wrangler config
events.input: $ sed -n 1,45p src/util.ts | grep -n ":" | head -40; ls wrangler.*; grep -n "database_name\|\"binding\"" wrangler.json* 2>/dev/null | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check seat binary, ports, apply local migrations
events.input: $ ls -la seat/.build/release/tantra-live-control 2>&1 | tail -1; lsof -ti:8880,8882 | head; P=/tmp/t226probe; rm -rf $P; mkdir -p $P; npx wrangler d1 migrations apply revops-centre --local --persist-to $P 2>&1 | tail -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start simulator, local centre, rebuild seat
events.input: $ (SIM_PORT=8882 SIM_STATE=/tmp/t226probe/sim.json nohup python3 scripts/vendor-sim.py > /tmp/t226probe/sim.log 2>&1 & echo sim $!) ; AK=$(openssl rand -hex 16); BK=$(openssl rand -hex 16); echo "$AK $BK" > /tmp/t226probe/keys; (nohup npx wrangler dev --port 8880 --persist-to /tmp/t226probe --var ADMIN_KEY:$AK --var ZOOM_BOT_KEY:$BK --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8882 > /tmp/t226probe/wr.log 2>&1 & echo wr $!); (cd seat && swift build -c release 2>&1 | tail -2)

events.text: Local centre and simulator are starting; running the Live Control probe next.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for centre and run probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app && for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8880/ && break; sleep 2; done; read AK BK < /tmp/t226probe/keys; CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8880 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8882 ADMIN_KEY=$AK BOT_KEY=$BK PERSIST=/tmp/t226probe timeout 280 node scripts/probe-live-control.mjs > /tmp/t226probe/probe.log 2>&1; echo exit $?; grep -c PASS /tmp/t226probe/probe.log; grep -v "^PASS" /tmp/t226probe/probe.log | head -15

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run Live Control probe
events.input: $ read AK BK < /tmp/t226probe/keys; CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8880 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8882 ADMIN_KEY=$AK BOT_KEY=$BK PERSIST=/tmp/t226probe node scripts/probe-live-control.mjs > /tmp/t226probe/probe.log 2>&1; echo exit $?; grep -c PASS /tmp/t226probe/probe.log; grep -v "^PASS" /tmp/t226probe/probe.log | head -15
